title: Second-PDK replication of the selected g v2 recipe on measured IHP SG13G2 MOSFETs (PSP103), 300 K, 18 DEV DUTs, LODO within class; accuracy only, Part B not run
not_done_before: any I17-2 run, training, refit or penalty-grid simulation
only pre-check: re-simulation of stored starting-card curves of 3 DEV DUTs (max relative difference 0)

dataset.chosen: IHP SG13G2 (I5-1 data), 300 K, DEV 18 DUTs from I5_1/split.json; TEST locked
dataset.why: only measured dataset with a non-sky130 foundry PDK card; GF180 has no measured data; TU Delft uses a generic example card

candidates.TU_Delft: measured, BSIM4 CMOSedu example card, ngspice-41

folds: leave-one-DUT-out within class (LV 9 / HV 7 training DUTs), record load order

arms.M_bias_v1: fit_bias I3-2 recipe, abs inputs / class VDD, 5 seeds, 2000 steps
arms.sym_e1_l{0,1,2,5,10}: fit_v2, sym_v2 inputs, EPS 0.01 V, vdd = class VDD (1.2 LV, 3.3 HV), lambda in V, 5 seeds
arms.selected: per outer fold the sym_e1_l{lambda*_h} row

penalty_grid.axes: u_g, u_d in {0, VDD/74, ..., VDD} (75 x 75), forward quadrant, Vb = 0, 300 K, starting card

selection.inner_folds: training DUTs sorted by (pmos, tag), i mod 3
selection.score: mean ln RRMS of inner held-out refits (non-finite -> 0)

primary.gain over C0_refit replicated: CI upper < 1 and 0 failed DUTs in selected and C0_refit

reported: GMR of every arm vs C0_refit and v1
negative corrected gm / gds fractions on penalty grids

reasons: BSIM4 channel replica does not apply; PSP103 replica needs SWIGATE=SWIMPACT=SWGIDL=SWJUNCAP=0, zero overlap/fringe charge parameters, VCCS for the DI-BP and SI-BP gmin conductances

PSP103 intrinsic charges Qg, Qb, Qd are contributed unconditionally (PSP103_module.include 1788-1790): the sensed replica current includes displacement current, the Q2 capacitance check fails by construction; needs an edited PSP103 Verilog-A, a different element
ngspice-41 OSDI build loads OSDI 0.3 only; psp103.osdi is OSDI 0.4

validity.V1: C0_refit and M_bias v1 rerun rows reproduce I5-1 lodo_300K rows, max |diff| <= 1e-9 on 18 DUTs each
validity.V2: unit tests tests.test_i17_2_ihp, tests.test_i12_1_symm, tests.test_i15_2_ablate pass
validity.V3: 18 rows in every arm; inner complete (18 x 3 x 5 trained, every inner held-out DUT scored)
validity.V4: 18 penalty grids 75 x 75 finite; forward current > 0 at u_g = u_d = VDD

decision.invalid: any validity fail -> stop: fix and re-register
decision.valid: primary label + secondary label; Part B not run

order: prereg (alone) -> code + unit tests -> smoke (lv_nmos_W0p15_L0p18, hv_nmos_W0p3_L0p5; 200 steps, 1 seed, refit max_nfev 20) -> queue I17_2_pens, I17_2_base, I17_2_lodo_l{0,1,2,5,10}, I17_2_inner, I17_2_decide
